hypothesis: createReservationItems_ (lines 292-307) and the reservation update path compute reserved_quantity as an absolute value from a level read before the lock-free write. With two servers on one database, two processes reserving the last unit concurrently can each read reserved=0, each write reserved=1, so reserved_quantity drops below the live reservation sum (2 reservation rows, reserved 1), tripping reserved_matches_reservations and possibly no_oversell.
